items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: There was five different singers — Vic Damone, Jack Jones, Joe Williams, Diane Carroll and Patti Page.

ctx.x: Well they’d already used the World’s Greatest Jazz Band, so—
And then we also did, for these same people, a Christmas album that was kind of interesting. There was five different singers — Vic Damone, Jack Jones, Joe Williams, Diane Carroll and Patti Page.
